WITH state_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count
    FROM Customers
    GROUP BY state_county_province
),
state_shares AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        customer_count,
        1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share_of_customers
    FROM state_customer_counts
),
state_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share_of_customers) AS average_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ss.customer_count) AS combined_account_base,
    AVG(ss.share_of_customers) AS average_share,
    AVG(ss.share_of_customers - sa.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM state_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN state_average AS sa
WHERE ss.share_of_customers > sa.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: “Account base” means number of customers in each state/province; NULL state values are grouped together as their own state.
